text: This staff report is a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. This report identifies and rectifies a conflicting stop control by-law on Granby Street at Mutual Street and Church Street by introducing a "housekeeping" by-law amendment.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing stop control on Granby Street at Mutual Street. 2. Authorized a stop control for westbound traffic on Granby Street at Church Street.
